units.source_text: 匂亲王走进室内，对二女公子说：“有一个叫作常陆守夫人的人，和这里有来往么？

en.t: Prince Niou went into the room and said to the Second Princess, "Is there a woman called the wife of the Governor of Hitachi who comes and goes here?

units.source_text: 在这晓色苍茫的时候匆匆乘车出门，那车副等人非常神气呢。”

en.t: At this dim hour of dawn she hurried out in a carriage, and those carriage attendants looked very proud of themselves."

units.source_text: 二女公子听了觉得难受，颇感痛苦，答道：“这个人是大辅君年轻时的朋友，

en.t: The Second Princess felt distressed and rather hurt when she heard this, and replied, "That woman was a friend of Lady Taifu when she was young,

units.source_text: 又不是什么了不起的人物，你何必大惊小怪呢！

en.t: and she is not anyone of great importance, so why must you make such a fuss?

units.source_text: 你只管疑神疑鬼，说这种难听的话。

en.t: You keep suspecting things for no reason and saying such unpleasant words.
Please, do not falsely accuse me!"

units.source_text: 说着背转了身，姿态娇美可爱。

en.t: As she said this she turned her back, and her figure was graceful and charming.

units.source_text: 这一晚匂亲王睡得好，不知东方之既白。

en.t: That night Prince Niou slept soundly and did not notice that the eastern sky had already grown pale.

units.source_text: 许多人来访问，他才走出正殿来。

en.t: Only when many people came to visit did he finally come out from the main hall.

units.source_text: 原来明石皇后并无大病，今已痊愈，因此诸人皆甚快慰。

en.t: It turned out that the Akashi Empress had not been seriously ill and had now recovered, so everyone was greatly relieved.

units.source_text: 夕雾左大臣家几位公子相与赛棋，又做掩韵游戏。

en.t: Several young gentlemen from the household of Yugiri, the Minister of the Left, competed with one another at go and also played a hidden-rhyme game.
